tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅: :shog tshad nges pa'i kha byang sgron ma

rang gsal bzhugs: tshad ldan rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje lta bu'i ye shes chen po de: gnyis med dbang po'i yul du rtogs bya'i phyir: rang snang bcar la 'bebs pa'i thabs dag ni: bla ma'i byin rlabs sngon gyi skal ba dang : rang gi dad pa mos gus byas pa la: brten nas gnyis med rang snang bde ba che: dbang po rnams kyi dwangs ma gang yin la: brten nas rdo rje lu gu rgyud de nyid: mngon sum gsal bar gtan la dbab pa'i phyir: gzhan du bstan pa med pa'i yi ge nyid: rnam bzhi kha byang rnams su ma bkod pa'i: gsang chen snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams pa la: yi ge'i 'brel po shog bu'i grangs nyid ni: 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir na 'di dag nyid: bla ma'i gdams pa snying po'i rgyud rnams la: brten nas 'khrul pa med pa'i blo gros kyis: rang bzhin rdzogs chen rnams kyi bcud phyungs pa: gsang ba'i man ngag bzhi yi rgyan 'di bkod: yang gsang dril ba'i man ngag 'di dag la: snying thig gsang ba nges pa'i gnad dang bstun: mngon sum nyid de rgyab nas 'byung ba min: snying po nges pa'i rang bzhin 'di lta bu: phyis kyang 'byung bar shin tu dkon pa 'o: de yi don gyi tshad ni 'di lta bu: gzhan gyis bsgyur cing gzhig par dka' ba'i phyir: shog tshad snod kyi bye brag 'di lta ste: rin chen lnga yi rang byung byang bu ni: sus kyang byas shing bzo yis ma bsgrubs pa: 'byung ba'i dgra dang bral ba'i byang bu ni: bzhi cu brgyad ste sus kyang bshig tu med: rang byung yi ge skad kyi rigs ltar snang : rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bgrang gis mi langs pa'i: byin brlabs nyid las rang snang nyid du shar: rin chen shel kyi glegs shing bar du gtems: rnam bdun rin chen gzer chen bzhi yis bsdams: bstan pa thams cad 'dus pa'i bu gcig po: rang byung yi ge 'byung ba'i sgra dang bral: bcangs pa tsam gyis bla med 'bras bu thob:

de phyir yi ge 'di nyid gsang bar bya: a+thi+-i: rin chen mthing sngon byang bu bcu drug la: rin chen gser gyi yi ges spras pa ste: zangs kyi dra ba'i nang du bcug pa ni: 'das rjes gsum pa nyid de rab tu gsang : a+thi+-iḥ ra gan glegs pa'i byang bu lnga bcu la: dkar po dung zhun yi ges btab pa ni: gsang ba dung yig can te 'di yang gsang : a+thi+-iḥ ra gan glegs pa'i byang bu drug cu la: dmar po zangs zhun yi ger btab pa ni: rin chen mchong gi glegs shing bar du gtems: rin chen lnga yi gzer chen gnyis kyis bsdams: bse yi sgrom bu khong nag nang du bstsal: gsang ba'i man ngag zangs yig can de ni: rab tu gsang bas rnal 'byor don rab 'grub: de yi phyir na yang gsang dril pa'i bcud: su la'ang mi bstan rang gi snying la phur: snying gi man ngag yi ge rnam pa bzhi: gzhan la ma ster rang gi sems la sbos: a+thi+-i: :de dag rnams kyi bu yi shog gu'i tshad: yi ge'i rgyu dang snod kyi bye brag ni: rin chen mthing shog byang bu bcu drug la: ser po gser gyis yi ge btab pa ni: dar chen lngas dril gser gyi skud pas bcings : rdo rje 'chang gsung mchod 'os rang bzhin tshig: 'di nyid kyis ni bstan pa bu gcig gi: man ngag yig sna lhag ma med par rdzogs: gzhan la gsang ste tshig tu mi brjod do: a+thi+-iḥ pra khrid rnam pa gnyis la shog dril chung ba gcig: kha byang rnam pa gnyis la shog dril chung ba gcig: rtags kyi yi ge nyid la shin tu chung ba gcig: gsang ba'i tshad yig la yang shin tu chung ba gcig : 'di dag rin chen gser gyi skud pas sbrail nas ni: mu tig sngon po'i dra ba'i nang du bcug nas dril: gsang ba rgyab yig nyid la po ti chag gang pa: glegs shing phra mo gser gyi 'jim bag can gyis gtems: lcags kyi gzer chen sgo lcags kyis btang ste: za 'og gur khyim gser thig can gyis dril: 'di dag rnams kyis snying thig zangs yig gi

: man ngag yig sna lhag chad med par rdzogs: 'di dag rang gi sems la brnag par bya: skal med la bstan mkha' 'gros snying khrag 'jibs: de bas sems kyi bu gcig ma gtogs pa: tshig gi zur tsam gzhan la bstan pa 'am: brjod cing bshad par mi bya sems la phur: gal te skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig dang : phrad de ster na dbang bzhi rdzogs byas la : 'di nyid bstan te nyams su blangs pa yis: rdo rje 'chang dang mnyam pa nyid du yang : 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom ci ste za: dbang bzhi rdzogs pa'i skal ldan snying gi bu: sku gsum nyid dang mnyam par 'di nyid la: smos ci dgos te de nyid rang yin no: de yi phyir na 'di yang rab tu gsang : a+thi+-i: kha byang gsum po gong dang 'dra ba la: tshad dang rtags yig gnyis la shog dril chung ba gcigaḥ gsang ba rgyab yig la ni po ti phyed: de dag dung gi ba thag dkar pos sbre la nas ni: dung gi ga'u sbrul chen 'khyil ba'i nang na yod: de dag rnams kyis gsang ba dung yig gi: bu yig tshad rnams gtan la phab pa yin: 'di dag rnams kyi ma dang bu yig ni: kun la gsang ngo rang gi sems la brnags: byang khog dmar po'i nang du a tham mo: gsang chen man ngag dam pa 'di nyid ni: skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig ma gtog par: lung med sems can don ma mi mos la: rlung dang ser bu'i phyogs tsam nyid du yang : bsgrag par bya ba min no sems kyi bu: rab tu gsang bas dngos grub ci dgar rol: de yi phyir na rang gi snying la phur: a+thi+-iḥ gsang chen man ngag dam pa rnam pa bzhi: su la'ang bstan pa med pa snying gi nor: yang gsang bcud bsdus yi ge dkar dmar gnyis: mtshan tsam brjod par su yang mi phod do: 'brid mkhan g.yon can kha gsag slu ba yis: 'di nyid kha drangs phrid de ming tsam yang : gal te mchan tshig tsam du 'di shor na: de la dgos pa'i don du 'dra min gnyis: ming mthun don du khyad par che bar bstan: gsang ba snying gi snying thig 'di dag nyid:

kha byang rnams kyi nang du bkod pa med: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang 'di: sus kyang mthong du rung ba ma yin no: de yi phyir na snying 'dra'i gdams pa 'di: nags klong nyid dam dur khrod mi med par: grogs med gcig pur 'dug ste 'di nyid la: nyams su blangs te grub pa'i 'bras bu bden: gsang ba 'di ni bde chen gsang ba'i gnad: gzhan du med de 'di nyid bcud phyungs nas: sangs rgyas rnams kyis gshegs pa'i shul de nyid: 'di nyid rang du tshad la phab nas ni: bla ma'i zhal la lus pa med par yang : tshig don gsal bar yi ge nyid du bkod: rang rig rgyu rkyen gnyis la ma ltos pas: shes rab kyis ni spyod yul min pa'i phyir: dbang po nyid la rno dang rtul med par: 'di nyid mthong ste don rig nyams blangs na: gsang sngags rnams kyi 'bras bu 'di nyid la: thob par 'gyur ba 'di la the tshom med: de yi phyir na gsang ba nges pa'i gnad: bshad cing bstan pa mi dgos ngo mtshar che: yang dag ye shes tshig gis mi rtogs te: mngon sum rang gnad tshad 'di ngo mtshar che: rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i don de nyid: dge sdig gnyis kyis phan gnod la bzlas phyir: dbang po nyid dang 'brel ba ngo mtshar che: smra bsam brjod du med pa'i don de nyid: gzhan gyis bshad pas de don mi rnyed phyir: rang gi gnad las byung ba ngo mtshar che: gsang ba chen po sus kyang ma rnyed pa: theg pa thun mong rnams las khyad 'phags phyiraḥ nges pa'i don nyid gsungs pa ngo mtshar cheḥ bla ma'i man ngag rkyen la rag ma lus: rang snang dbang po'i gnad dang bstun nas ni: sngon chad mthong ma myong ba'i yul de nyidaḥ goms shing sbyongs pa mi dgos cig car du: stong pa'i yul la lhag mthong nyid du yong : las la dag dang ma dag med pa'i mis: mngon sum nyid du mthong bar gyur pa la: the tshom yod pa nyid ni ma yin no: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i thabs chen 'di:

sangs rgyas thugs rje ldan pa rnams kyis kyang : snying thig 'di ni brjod par nus ma yin: de yi phyir na sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: rdo rje 'chang la dbang bzhi rdzogs byas nas: gsang ba mchog la dbang bar dbang bskur bas: nyid kyi gsang don 'di ni brjod pa las: gzhan gyis gsung zhing bstan par nus mi srid: de yi phyir na thabs chen snying bcud 'di: rab tu gsang bar bya 'o sa ma yāḥ shog gu'i tshad dang yi ge'i rgyud nyid dang : snod dang bcas pa gsang ba'i yi ger bkod: 'di yi dge bas don dam de nyid la: dbang thob sku gsum lam du snang bar shog: shog tshad gsal ba'i kha byang : sgron ma rang gsal zhes bya ba: mkhas pa chen po bi ma la mi tras mdzad pa rdzogs so: dpal sngags srung gi rgyal mo e ka tsa tis srungs shig: sa ma yā: pa traṃ tra k+ṣa: athaṃ: :gter nas gter du dam par btsas nas bka' gzhan du ma 'khyar ba lags so: yi ge dkar dmar gnyis la 'dra min zhes kyang bya: mi 'dra ba'i yi ge gnyis bzhugs pa la: snying thig gi kha byang 'dir bkod pa'i ma bu rnams snying thig lags so: mi 'dra mi zab pa de la bu ma mchis : sa ma yāḥ rgya rgya rgyaḥ shubhaṃ: : mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (1)shog tshad nges pa'i kha byang sgron ma rang gsal/ -PAGE 44--PAGE 43--42-
